item.title: Third-Party Claim Documents: What You Need for Faster Settlement
item.description: A third party car insurance claim is document-driven because it involves proving liability towards another person. Insurers typically verify the accident details, vehicle information, and driver credentials through official records. When these documents are complete and consistent, the claim process is usually faster and involves fewer follow-ups.
